class.name: SteamPublisherAuth
class.brief_description: Verifies Steam Web API tickets and current ownership on the trusted backend.
class.description: Get this scoped service from [method SteamPublisher.auth]. The backend supplies its expected service audience and keeps ticket bytes out of logs and saved data.

method.name: verify
method.description: Sends the configured AppID, exact [param audience], and hex-encoded ticket to Valve. Use [code]await[/code] to receive [SteamIdentityResult]. Only an accepted ticket with a valid individual SteamID issues an identity.

method.name: owns_app
method.description: Checks Steam's current license for an identity minted by this exact publisher. Use [code]await[/code] to receive [SteamAppOwnershipResult]. A negative license is a successful query with [member SteamAppOwnership.owns_app] false.

method.name: verify_ownership
method.description: Verifies an encrypted app ticket locally against the configured AppID, exact [param expected_challenge], and optional DLC AppIDs. Checks the fresh ticket and consumes the one-time challenge through the trusted store before issuing an identity. Returns a typed error for invalid tickets, replay, or unavailable configuration.
